title: LYNE Protocol
description: LYNE is communication infrastructure for matters between parties without persistent personal addresses: a signed, versioned Thing and State, a purpose-bound and time-limited Grant, a temporary Live Line, and a Result signed by both parties that anchors the next State. LP 0.1 is the immutable baseline; LP 0.2 candidate-4 is an experimental candidate. The repository contains the specification texts, JSON Schemas, test vectors, examples and a language-neutral conformance kit.
